text: Upgrade cozo from 0.7 to 0.8+ and remove fd-lock workaround in connect_db once upstream SQLITE_BUSY unwrap panic is fixed (U015-FLK1)

Extend fd-lock scope in connect_db to cover schema bootstrap: move run_schema_bootstrap inside spawn_blocking closure so concurrent schema writes on the same DB path cannot race (intra-process SQLITE_BUSY variant of U015-FLK1). Alternatively, upgrade to cozo 0.8+ which handles SQLITE_BUSY gracefully and removes the need for fd-lock entirely.
